text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Wha-what's this!? I feel like strength is 
welling up inside me!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Could this mean... it's all thanks to the 
Goddesses?!

text_block_list.name: Ines Fujin
text_block_list.text:
Huh...? If that's the case, did they call 
the wrong person...?
